One of the ways to accelerate the tax write-offs on your investment properties is with a charitable lead trust. This is a charitable planning vehicle that allows you to take an upfront tax deduction for the donation of future income streams of your asset. The other benefit is that CLT deductions are not limited by the excess business loss limitations. It is limited instead by your adjusted gross income.
